title: Protocol to quantify polyphosphate in human cell lines using a tagged PPBD peptide
protocol: Put 12 mm diameter coverslips in P24 culture plate wells.
Add 90 μL of commercial poly-L-lysine solution for 1 hour.
Wash three times using PBS.
Take the culture medium carefully from the flask.
Wash once using pre-warmed 5–10 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL of trypsin and incubate for 3 minutes at the cell culture incubator.
Add 4 mL of pre-warmed fresh culture medium and harvest the cells.
Eliminate the trypsin by centrifugation at 300 × g for 3 minutes.
Suspend the cells in pre-warmed fresh medium.
Seed 8 × 10^4 cells/mL in the P24 plate from step 1.
Spread the cells by performing round movements to ensure a homogeneous cell distribution on the coverslip.
Incubate for 24 hours in the cell incubator until reaching 60%–70% confluency.
Aspirate the culture medium carefully.
Add 0.5 mL of para-formaldehyde 4% (v/v).
Incubate the coverslip containing fixed cells for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash three times with 0.5 mL of PBS.
Remove the washing solution and prepare blocking buffer (PBS, goat serum 2.5%, Tween20 0.5%).
Incubate the coverslip in 0.5 mL of blocking buffer for 1 hour without shaking.
Mix anti-Xpress antibody (5 μg/mL) with recombinant 6×His-Xpress-PPBD (20 μg/mL) in blocking buffer and incubate for 1 hour at 4°C on a rotating shaker.
Remove the mixture, add 250 μL of PPBD and anti-Xpress antibody mix to the coverslip.
Incubate with the mixture overnight at 4°C.
Wash three times for 5 minutes using 0.5 mL of PBS at 20°C with gentle agitation.
Incubate with 0.5 mL of Alexa Fluor 488 or 633 secondary antibody (1:1000) in blocking solution for 1 hour at 20°C with gentle shaking.
Wash three times for 5 minutes using 0.5 mL of PBS at 20°C with gentle agitation.
Add 0.5 mL of Hoechst (final concentration 1 μg/mL) in PBS and incubate for 5 minutes at 20°C with gentle agitation.
Wash three times for 5 minutes using 0.5 mL of PBS at 20°C with gentle agitation.
Put the coverslip upside down on a slide using a drop of mounting solution.
Keep the mounted slides protected from light.
Configure the Leica DMi8 microscope with TCS SP8 confocal module.
Set up a Leica 63× 1.4NA HC Apo CS2 immersion oil objective.
Excite Hoechst using the 405 nm laser channel.
Excite Alexa Fluor 488 or 633 using their corresponding laser channels.
Acquire images sequentially at 400 Hz.
Set pixel size to 240.5 × 240.5 nm and image size to 246.03 × 246.03 μm.
Adjust zoom to 0.75.
Set pinhole to 1 UA for both excitation wavelengths.
Adjust laser energy power between 0.5 and 2%.
Set gain between 700 and 900.
Set offset between -10 and -20.
Collect emission using a Leica PMT detector with collection windows of 408–475 nm, 498–550 nm, and 648–800 nm.
Keep laser energy and/or PMT gain below maximum to prevent photobleaching.
Take a minimum of 10 shots for every condition in three independent experiments.
Save pictures in .LIF format using LAS X or ImageJ Fiji.

Open LIF file in ImageJ by selecting File>Open, then choose Bio-Formats Import options with Dataset organization set to "open all series" and Color mode set to "colorized". Split into separate windows for channel separation.
Select the Hoechst (blue) channel.
Apply Gaussian blur filter with a value of 2 at “sigma (Radius)”.
Adjust threshold settings by selecting "dark background", default over/under, or manually adjust sliders until nuclei are delimited. Click apply to obtain a binary mask.
Fill holes in the binary mask using Process>Binary>Fill Holes.
Create watershed separation with Process>Binary>Watershed.
Define regions of interest (ROIs) using Analyze>Analyze Particles.
Click OK to get ROIs for further analysis.
Go to Analyze particles>size (micron²).
Exclude on edges in Clear results>add to manager.
Open ROI manager and check all generated ROIs according to selected parameters.
Apply threshold around 50 in 8 bits images for signal quantification.
Select the green (polyP) channel, then image>adjust>threshold.
Choose "dark background" with default settings.
Adjust sliders manually until unspecific signal disappears.
Do not click on “apply” after setting the threshold to avoid alterations in quantification.
Click on ROI manager and select “show all” to overlay ROIs over the image to be quantified.
Analyze set measurements, selecting at least “integrated density (intDent)” and “limit to threshold”.
Measure to quantify signal intensity.
Measure fluorescence intensity using the parameter "intDent".
Analyze at least 400 cells in each of 3 independent experiments.
Include a minimum of 5 fields with 30–100 cells for analysis.
Apply Mann-Whitney test using GraphPad Prism software for statistical significance.
